request.prompt: Input 1 is the existing Buki horizontal album screen; input 2 is the bear and coral book brand reference. Redesign it as a modern child-friendly mobile scrapbook UI. Keep the top header light and compact, center a landscape one-page pad, retain one circular camera action. The pad should feel distinct: stitched left binding, clearly framed wide artwork area, visible modular dot grid, layered paper edge, rounded geometric stickers, and balanced spacing. Lilac Garden palette: lilac #8C6DD7, leaf green #78B159, apricot #F7A66A, aqua #6CD4C5, deep plum #4D3766, warm paper #FFF7F0, cream background #FAF3E6. Soft felt and cut-paper craft with modern minimal geometry, playful without clutter, realistic for Expo and Skia. No phone frame, no unrelated text, no gibberish, no photorealistic scene.
